title: SpaceX-Tesla Merger: Passive Flows ‘Hack’, Could Bring More BTC Exposure to S&P 500
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine SpaceX-Tesla Merger: Passive Flows ‘Hack’, Could Bring More BTC Exposure to S&P 500 Sean Hagan breaks down why a Tesla-SpaceX merger is a no-brainer, connecting passive index flows to Strategy's MSCI inclusion and S&P 500 entry. This post SpaceX-Tesla Merger: Passive Flows ‘Hack’, Could Bring More BTC Exposure to S&P 500 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
